outcome: Prediction of extraneous outcomes (mode of delivery, diet changes)
Identification of subpopulations with clinical relevance
cohort: Newborns with microbiomes available at 6 and 9 months after birth
finding: A novel data analysis framework (MNDA) combining representation learning and individual-specific microbial co-occurrence networks can uncover taxon neighborhood dynamics and improve prediction of extraneous outcomes compared to traditional methods based solely on microbial abundances.
mod_finding: Prediction models for mode of delivery based on MNDA measure of local neighborhood dynamics for each taxon outperform traditional prediction models solely based on individual-specific microbial abundances.
